evidence: Places block tree storage under src/kernel/, changes kernel APIs, and directly aims to enable concurrent block/header reading for external libbitcoinkernel consumers.
rationale: Removing LevelDB's exclusive lock allows external kernel consumers like Electrs and Esplora to inspect block and header metadata concurrently without shutting down Bitcoin Core. However, because this also completely re-architects core block storage persistence, it substantively changes validation logic and spans both domains.
